name: tour-llm (act 1: the first result, annotated live on a real conversation)
notes: Needs a model: run with `just desktop-dev-automation-seeded-llama scripts/automation/tour-llm.json <model.gguf>`. The deterministic half of the tour system lives in tour-det.json.

Act 1 is the only tour with the annotated presentation: it points at a live approval card, so it must NOT dim the app and must NOT trap focus. tour-spotlight is therefore asserted ABSENT throughout, which is the regression guard for that distinction.
Starting the tour pushes into openNewChatRequested, the store the sidebar button and the command palette already write to, so the picker opens and annotation 1 anchors on quickpicker-textarea.
The approval step docks to the top edge while its card is absent (TourStepCard annotated anchorless dock), so the annotation never covers the conversation and its Next button stays reachable.

Turn is driven with awaitTurn (auto-accepts the HITL card whether or not it appears: bash non-git raises it, but appearance is model-dependent). awaitTurn now handles both the builder (approval-accept-) and operator (operator-approval-accept-) cards. The annotation text is shown regardless; the card, when present, is auto-accepted so the turn completes.
